title: Choice of entity — Nora's design firm
instructions: Nora is forming a design business that will earn **$400,000** of taxable income a year. Compare the federal income tax under the alternatives. Assume: Nora's marginal rate on ordinary income is **35%**; qualified dividends are taxed at **23.8%** (20% + 3.8% NIIT); the QBI deduction (20%) is available for pass-through income; ignore payroll and SE taxes and state taxes.

exhibits.title: Alternatives
exhibits.content:
1. C corporation that distributes all after-tax profit each year as a qualified dividend
2. C corporation that retains all profit
3. LLC taxed as a partnership (Nora and a minority partner; Nora's share is 100% of the $400,000 for this analysis)

rows.label: Lowest tax if Nora needs all profit each year
rows.explanation: One level of tax at 28% effective beats 39.8%.

rows.label: Main risk of Alternative 2 over many years
rows.explanation: Retaining earnings beyond reasonable business needs.

rows.label: Default classification of the LLC with two members
rows.explanation: Two or more owners default to partnership.

rows.label: Form used to elect corporate status for the LLC
